title: Jason Licht on Baker Mayfield contract: We'll figure it out at some point

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Jason Licht on Baker Mayfield contract: We'll figure it out at some point
sources.description: Buccaneers quarterback Baker Mayfield's contract status has been a topic of conversation around the team this offseason and General Manager Jason Licht didn't have much of an update on Monday.
